title: build(deps): bump @supabase/supabase-js from 2.116.0 to 2.117.2
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. @supabase/supabase-js 2.116.0 -> 2.117.2 in packages/client, which moves the whole @supabase family in lockstep. Spans three releases: 2.117.0 (auth: passkey API enabled by default, experimental passkey opt-in deprecated), 2.117.1 (auth fix: return the stored session when a token refresh loses a race to another tab), 2.117.2 (supabase-js itself is a version-alignment bump with no code changes; postgrest-js fixes TypeScript instantiation-depth errors for large relationship unions -- types only). No repository code adopts any new API. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001); the payload of that friction is the lockfile audit in behavior_change.
behavior_change: No declared-dependency movement beyond the titled family; one small runtime effect on the live auth path, stated rather than hidden. Lockfile audited against merge base d989d542 by parsing both package-lock.json trees and comparing every `packages` entry in full, not by reading the diff view. Entry count is 412 before and 412 after. Exactly six node_modules entries changed, all the @supabase family moving 2.116.0 -> 2.117.2 in lockstep: auth-js, functions-js, postgrest-js, realtime-js, storage-js, supabase-js -- each changing only version, resolved and integrity, except supabase-js, whose `dependencies` map also changed. That map was checked key by key (the #296 hiding place): same key set before and after, and its only movements are the five sibling pins 2.116.0 -> 2.117.2. Zero packages added, zero removed, zero non-@supabase entries touched. The root entry differs in one key, dependencies.@supabase/supabase-js ^2.116.0 -> ^2.117.2. Runtime: the sole client constructor, src/auth/supabase.ts, is reachable from src/main.ts, so this bump reaches users. The app calls only auth APIs (getSession, onAuthStateChange, signInWithPassword, signUp, signOut, signInWithOAuth) with createClient auth {autoRefreshToken, persistSession, detectSessionInUrl}; it does not use passkeys/WebAuthn anywhere in src, so the 2.117.0 passkey default exposes an API the app never calls. The 2.117.1 fix does touch a path the app uses -- autoRefreshToken + persistSession across multiple open tabs: a refresh that loses to another tab now returns the stored (fresh) session instead of surfacing the loss. That is a correctness improvement for multi-tab users, not a semantic change to single-tab login.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json moves the single declared range for @supabase/supabase-js from ^2.116.0 to ^2.117.2 -- one line, no other dependency touched. package-lock.json resolves the family: auth-js, functions-js, postgrest-js, realtime-js, storage-js and supabase-js 2.116.0 -> 2.117.2, plus supabase-js's own sibling pins. No incidental version movement outside the family; the added, removed and non-@supabase changed sets are all empty.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency, stated plainly. No existing manifest covers this diff; the prior family manifest (supabase-js-2.116.0-bump) would cover these two files, and borrowing it is what CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 refuses.
